z-m-35-03.title: Vadzidzi vangani vakabatana nemaklabhu ose maviri? Tinoda kuziva chii chimwe?
z-m-35-03.topic: Nhamba ye elements ye union, neruzivo rwunodiwa
z-m-35-03.goal: Wana huwandu hunosarudzwa nehukama pakati penhamba dze elements oga, siyanisa ruzivo rwunodiwa kugadzirisa kukosha kuita kumwe neruzivo rusiri, uye uvake iwe amene mamiriro anogoneka.
z-m-35-03.material: Pavadzidzi 40 vechikoro chose, 30 ndivo nhengo dzeklabhu A uye 25 ndivo nhengo dzeklabhu B. Pangava nevadzidzi vakabatana nemaklabhu ose maviri nevadzidzi vasina kubatana neklabhu chero ipi. Rega x ive nhamba yevadzidzi vakabatana nemaklabhu ose maviri, uye z nhamba yevadzidzi vasina kubatana neklabhu chero ipi. Pazasi, tinoongorora zvinogona kuzivikanwa nezve x.
z-m-35-03.thinking.1: Kuongorora ruzivo runoita sehurisina basa neequation
z-m-35-03.thinking.2: Kuvaka mamiriro akawanda anogoneka mukati mezvirambidzo
z-m-35-03.prereq.1: Fomula yenhamba ye elements ye union yema sets maviri
z-m-35-03.prereq.2: Kuti mukati me universal set pangava ne elements dzisiri dzeset chero ipi
z-m-35-03.s.s1.prompt: Kubva paruzivo rwakapihwa zvino (40, 30, 25) oga, unogona kutaura chii nechokwadi nezve x?
z-m-35-03.s.s1.hint.0: Fungidzira x i0 uye uverenge vadzidzi vakasiyana vangani vakabatana nemaklabhu maviri zvose.
z-m-35-03.s.s1.hint.1: Chinja x kukosha kumwe panguva uye uongorore kana 'nhamba yevadzidzi vakasiyana vakabatana' inopfuura 40 uye kana x inopfuura 25.
z-m-35-03.s.s1.r.a: 15 ikukosha kana mudzidzi wese akabatana neklabhu imwe kana kupfuura. Ongorora kana chokwadi ichocho chakapihwa mudambudziko.
z-m-35-03.s.s1.o.b: x haina kugadziriswa uye inogona kuva kukosha kupi neupi kubva pa0 kusvika pa25
z-m-35-03.s.s1.r.b: Kana x i0, wana huwandu hwenhengo hunosvika vadzidzi vangani uye uhuenzanise ne40.
z-m-35-03.s.s1.o.c: x iri kubva pa15 kusvika pa25
z-m-35-03.s.s1.r.c: Kutonga uku kunoshandisa pamwe mamiriro ekuti union haigone kupfuura nhamba yevadzidzi vechikoro chese nemamiriro ekuti x haigone kupfuura nhamba yenhengo dzeklabhu imwe.
z-m-35-03.s.s1.o.d: Ruzivo hahuna kukwana, saka hapana chinogona kutaurwa nezve x
z-m-35-03.s.s1.r.d: Kusagadzwa kuita mutengo mumwe hakureve kuti haugone kuziva range. Edza mitengo mishoma inogoneka iwe pachako.
z-m-35-03.s.s1.explain: Nhamba yema elements e A∪B i 30+25−x=55−x, uye haigone kupfuura vadzidzi 40 vechikoro chese, saka 55−x≤40, ndiko kuti, x≥15. Uyewo x haigone kupfuura nhengo 25 dza B, saka x≤25. Zvose 15 ne 25 zvinogoneka chaizvo (15 i chiitiko apo munhu wese akapinda, uye 25 i chiitiko apo nhengo dzese dza B dzakapindawo mu A), saka unogona kutaura kuti x i kubva ku 15 kusvika ku 25.
z-m-35-03.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza zvidimbu zvese zveruzivo zviri pazasi apo kuziva chokwadi chimwe chete chimwe chinogadza x kuita mutengo mumwe chete. (Funga kuwedzera chidimbu cheruzivo chimwe nechimwe zvakasiyana, chimwe panguva.)
z-m-35-03.s.s2.hint.0: Chinja chidimbu cheruzivo chimwe nechimwe kuita equation kana inequality mu x.
z-m-35-03.s.s2.hint.1: Rongedza mhedzisiro kuti inopa mutengo mumwe we x, inopa range chete, kana kudzokorora chokwadi chawakatoziva.
z-m-35-03.s.s2.o.a: Pane vadzidzi 6 vasina kupinda mumakirabhu ese maviri
z-m-35-03.s.s2.r.a: Neruzivo urwu, nhamba yevadzidzi vakasiyana vakapinda yakagadzwa. Verenga kana unogona kutsvaga x kubva panhamba iyoyo.
z-m-35-03.s.s2.o.b: Pane vadzidzi 5 vakawanda vakapinda mu A bedzi kupfuura vakapinda mu B bedzi
z-m-35-03.s.s2.r.b: Nyora mitengo miviri nenzira ye x, verenga musiyano, uye utarise kana x ichisara kana kuparara.
z-m-35-03.s.s2.o.c: Vadzidzi vakapinda mu A kana B i 80% kana kupfuura yechikoro chese
z-m-35-03.s.s2.r.c: Mamiriro ane 'kana kupfuura' anosiya range, kwete mutengo mumwe. Nyora ma x mashoko anogoneka pasi pemamiriro aya.
z-m-35-03.s.s2.o.d: Pane vadzidzi 10 vakapinda mu B bedzi
z-m-35-03.s.s2.r.d: Tarisa kana inogona kushandiswa pakarepo kutsvaga vadzidzi pakati penhengo 25 dza B vakapindawo mu A.
z-m-35-03.s.s2.r.e: Verenga kana ruzivo rwehuwandu hwevarume nevakadzi runobatana nehukama hwekupinda, uye kana runobatana, nenzira ipi.
z-m-35-03.s.s2.explain: Kuna a, nhamba yevadzidzi vakasiyana vakapinda i 40−6=34, saka 55−x=34 uye x=21. Kuna d, nhamba yevakapinda mu B bedzi i 25−x=10, saka x=15. Kuna b, (30−x)−(25−x)=5 inogara yakarurama zvisinei ne x, saka haisi ruzivo rutsva. Kuna c, 55−x≥32, ndiko kuti, x≤23, saka range kubva ku 15 kusvika ku 23 chete inosara. e haibatani nehukama hwekupinda.
z-m-35-03.s.s3.prompt: Gadzira mamiriro 3 akasiyana anogutsa mamiriro ese. x i nhamba yevadzidzi vakapinda mumakirabhu ese maviri, uye z i nhamba yevadzidzi vasina kupinda mumakirabhu ese maviri. (A vadzidzi 30, B vadzidzi 25, chikoro chese 40)
z-m-35-03.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wagadza x imwe, wobva waverenga nhamba yevadzidzi vakasiyana vakapinda (30+25−x).
z-m-35-03.s.s3.hint.1: Kuenzanisa nhamba iyoyo ne 40 kunokuudza kuti z inofanira kuva yei. Dzokorora izvi uchichinja x.
z-m-35-03.s.s3.ok.c1: Nhamba dzose mbiri i integers 0 kana kupfuura.
z-m-35-03.s.s3.fail.c1: Nhamba yevadzidzi inofanira kuva integer 0 kana kupfuura.
z-m-35-03.s.s3.fail.c2: x haigone kuva hombe kupfuura nhengo 25 dza B.
z-m-35-03.s.s3.ok.c3: Nhamba yevadzidzi vakasiyana vakapinda pamwe nenhamba yevadzidzi vasina kupinda i 40.
z-m-35-03.s.s3.explain: z=x−15, saka kana x i integer kubva ku 15 kusvika ku 25, z=0 kusvika ku 10 dzinoenderana nayo. Mienzaniso: (15,0), (18,3), (21,6), (25,10).
z-m-35-03.s.s3.because.prompt: Mumamiriro matatu awakagadzira, z inochinja sei sezvo x ichikura? Tsanangura kuti nei, uchibatanidza nevadzidzi 40 vechikoro chese.
z-m-35-03.s.s3.because.hint.0: Chinja x kuita 15, 18, 25 uye ugadzire tafura yekuti z inochinja sei.
z-m-35-03.s.s3.because.hint.1: Enzanisa ne 40 chokwadi chekuti 55−x i nhamba yevadzidzi vakasiyana vakapinda chaizvo.
z-m-35-03.s.s3.because.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Kana x ichikura, z ... nekuti ...
z-m-35-03.s.s3.because.selfAssess.0: Ndakataura zvakajeka kuti z inoenda kunzira ipi kana x ichikura here?
z-m-35-03.s.s3.because.selfAssess.1: Ndakashandisa muchikonzero chekuti nhamba 55 i mutengo wakaverengwa uine kudzokorora here?
z-m-35-03.s.s3.because.model.0: Kana x ichikura, z inokurawo. Vadzidzi vakawanda vakapinda mumakirabhu ese maviri, nhamba yevadzidzi vakasiyana vakapinda (55−x) inoderera, saka nhamba yevadzidzi pa 40 vasina kupinda mumakirabhu ese maviri inokura.
z-m-35-03.s.s3.because.model.1: z = x − 15, saka kana x ichikwira ne 1, z inokwirawo ne 1. 55 i mutengo unoverenga vadzidzi vanopindirana kaviri, uye vadzidzi vakapinda chaizvo i 55−x, saka musiyano ne 40 i z.

z-m-35-01.title: Mhinduro inoti nhamba yevadzidzi vakanyoresa kuti havana kunyoresa chero rimwe i20
z-m-35-01.topic: Complement ye union ne intersection, nenhamba ye elements
z-m-35-01.goal: Wana mumutsara mumwe wemhinduro kukanganisa kunoitika kana 'kwete ... kwete ...' kwatendeudzirwa kuita set notation uye ukugadzirise, uye utaure kuti kuverenga kwakafanana kunoverenga ani chaizvo.
z-m-35-01.material: Rega vadzidzi 24 vekirasi vave universal set U. Mukunyoresa kwepashure pechikoro, rega A ive set yevadzidzi vakanyoresa nhabvu (vadzidzi 13) uye B vakanyoresa basketball (vadzidzi 10), uye vadzidzi 4 vakanyoresa zvose. Mudzidzi anogona kunyoresa zvose, kana kusanyoresa chero rimwe. Jisu akaedza kuwana 'nhamba yevadzidzi vakanyoresa kwete nhabvu kwete basketball' ndokuigadzirisa saizvi. (Maverengerwo ezviratidzo: Aᶜ i 'complement ye A', ∪ i 'union', ∩ i 'intersection', n(A) i 'nhamba ye elements dze A'.)
z-m-35-01.thinking.0: Kuwana mutsara wekutanga wemhinduro unoenda zvisirizvo
z-m-35-01.thinking.1: Kududzira kuti kukosha kwakaverengwa kuri kuverenga ani
z-m-35-01.prereq.0: H1 yebasa iri ingori chinyorwa chekuoma chebatch yekugadzira, kwete kuiswa kugiredhi mukharikhulamu. Inofungidzira kuti mudzidzi atodzidza kamwe chikamu che 'sets and propositions' cheCommon Mathematics yechikoro chesekondari (operations pa sets, proposition 'kana p ipapo q', nemienzaniso inopokana).
z-m-35-01.prereq.1: Unogona kushandisa hukama pakati penhamba dze elements dzema sets maviri (inclusion and exclusion).
z-m-35-01.prereq.2: Unoziva kuti 'uye' ne 'kana' zvinoenderana ne intersection ne union yema sets.
z-m-35-01.s.s1.prompt: Mutsara wekutanga uri kupi mumhinduro yaJisu umo kufunga kunoenda zvisirizvo? Nhamba dzemitsara dzinoverengwa kubva pa1.
z-m-35-01.s.s1.hint.0: Sarudza mudzidzi mumwe. Semuenzaniso, ongorora kana 'mudzidzi akanyoresa basketball chete' ari muset iri mumutsara 1.
z-m-35-01.s.s1.hint.1: Sarudza zvakaparadzana kana mudzidzi iyeye ari mumwe wa 'vadzidzi vakanyoresa kwete nhabvu kwete basketball', izvo dambudziko rinobvunza, uye uenzanise sarudzo mbiri idzi.
z-m-35-01.s.s1.line.0: 'Vadzidzi vakanyoresa kwete nhabvu kwete basketball' ndi 'vadzidzi vasina kunyoresa nhabvu' kana 'vadzidzi vasina kunyoresa basketball', saka set yatinoda i Aᶜ∪Bᶜ.
z-m-35-01.s.s1.line.3: Saka nhamba yevadzidzi vakanyoresa kwete nhabvu kwete basketball i20.
z-m-35-01.s.s1.explain: Kubatanidza 'havana kunyoresa nhabvu kana basketball' ne 'kana' mumutsara 1 ndipo pakatanga kuenda zvisirizvo. Kuti vasanyoresa chero rimwe, inofanira kuva 'havana kunyoresa nhabvu uye havana kunyoresa basketball futi', saka i Aᶜ∩Bᶜ, ndiko kuti (A∪B)ᶜ. Aᶜ∪Bᶜ=(A∩B)ᶜ mumutsara 2 inoshanda pachayo uye kuverenga kwemutsara 3 (24−4=20) kwakarurama futi, asi set yakasarudzwa mumutsara 1 yakasiyana, saka mhedziso yemutsara 4 haina kururama.
z-m-35-01.s.s2.prompt: 20 yakawanikwa naJisu inhamba yevadzidzi vapi? Sarudza tsananguro yakanakisa yevadzidzi vanoverengwa chaizvo nekuverenga 24 − 4.
z-m-35-01.s.s2.hint.0: Gadzira tebhura yevadzidzi vangani vakanyoresa nhabvu chete, basketball chete, uye zvose.
z-m-35-01.s.s2.hint.1: Pavadzidzi vose 24, nyora nemapoka kuti marudzi api evadzidzi ari mu20 yasara mushure mekubvisa 4.
z-m-35-01.s.s2.o.a: Vadzidzi vose vakanyoresa kwete nhabvu kwete basketball
z-m-35-01.s.s2.r.a: Wakaverenga chinangwa chaJisu chekutanga sezvachakaita. Ongorora kana vadzidzi vakanyoresa basketball chete vari mu20.
z-m-35-01.s.s2.r.b: Wakaverenga chaizvo, seset, kuti ndiani anosara kana vadzidzi 4 chete vakanyoresa zvose vabviswa kubva kuvose.
z-m-35-01.s.s2.r.c: 'Chimwe chete chete' chinofanira kubvisa vadzidzi vakanyoresa zvose nevadzidzi vasina kunyoresa chero rimwe. Ongorora kana chakafanana nekuverenga kunobvisa 4 chete kubva pa24.
z-m-35-01.s.s2.o.d: Vadzidzi vakanyoresa nhabvu uye vasina kunyoresa basketball
z-m-35-01.s.s2.r.d: Vadzidzi ivavo chikamu che A chine A∩B yabviswa. Ongorora kana izvi zvichienderana nekuverenga kunoshandisa 24 kubva kuvose.
z-m-35-01.s.s2.explain: 24−4 inobvisa vadzidzi 4 chete vakanyoresa zvose kubva kuvose, saka huwandu hwenhabvu chete (13−4=9 vadzidzi) + basketball chete (10−4=6 vadzidzi) + vadzidzi vasina kunyoresa chero rimwe. 9+6+(vadzidzi 5 vasina kunyoresa chero rimwe)=20, iyo inoenzana nenhamba ye elements dze (A∩B)ᶜ.
z-m-35-01.s.s3.prompt: Udza Jisu. Mumutsara mumwe kana miviri, nyora kuti mutsara upi wemhinduro unofanira kugadziriswa uye sei, vadzidzi vangani vakanyoresa kwete nhabvu kwete basketball mushure mekugadzirisa, uye wakaongorora sei kuti nhamba iyi yakarurama.
z-m-35-01.s.s3.hint.0: Kutanga, shandisa 'kana' yemutsara 1 sechirevo kumudzidzi mumwe, uye usarudze kuti inofanira kuchinjwa kuita chii.
z-m-35-01.s.s3.hint.1: Mushure mekuwana nhamba ye elements dzeset yakagadziriswa, wedzera nhamba dzevadzidzi vakanyoresa nhabvu chete, basketball chete, nezvose, uye uongorore kuti inoenderana ne24.
z-m-35-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ndakatsanangura here nemashoko angu kuti nei 'kwete ... kwete ...' inobatanidzwa ne 'uye'?
z-m-35-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ndakaongorora here kukosha 5 kamwe zvakare nekuverenga kumwe (semuenzaniso 24−19, kana kuwedzera nemapoka)?
z-m-35-01.s.s3.model.0: Mutsara 1 unofanira kugadziriswa. Kuti vasanyoresa chero rimwe, i 'kwete nhabvu uye kwete basketball', saka i Aᶜ∩Bᶜ, ndiko kuti (A∪B)ᶜ. n(A∪B)=13+10−4=19, saka 24−19=vadzidzi 5. Kuwedzera nhabvu chete 9, basketball chete 6, nezvose 4 kunopawo 19, saka zvinoenderana.
z-m-35-01.s.s3.model.1: 'Kwete ... kwete ...' inofanira kubatanidzwa ne 'uye' kwete 'kana', saka mutsara 1 unova Aᶜ∩Bᶜ. Mhinduro vadzidzi 5. Ongorora: nhabvu chete 9 + basketball chete 6 + zvose 4 + hapana 5 = 24, iyo inoenderana nehuwandu hwose.
z-m-35-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Mhinduro yakaongororwa nekuwedzera nemapoka panzvimbo pekushandisa fomula ye union.

z-m-35-02.prereq.0: H1 yebasa iri ingori chinyorwa chekuoma chebatch yekugadzira, kwete kuiswa kugiredhi mukharikhulamu. Inofungidzira kuti mudzidzi atodzidza kamwe chikamu che 'sets and propositions' cheCommon Mathematics yechikoro chesekondari (operations pa sets, proposition 'kana p ipapo q', nemienzaniso inopokana).
z-m-35-02.title: Kana pasina mudzidzi mumwe chete anopokana nacho, chiziviso chechokwadi here?
z-m-35-02.topic: Chokwadi nenhema ye proposition, nenyaya umo hapana element inogutsa mamiriro
z-m-35-02.goal: Shandisa chokwadi chekuti chokwadi che 'kana p ipapo q' chinosarudzwa nekuti pane muenzaniso unopokana here kugadzirisa kutonga nekuvimba kwako kana pasina element inogutsa p uye kana element itsva yasvika, uye utaure kuti nei.
z-m-35-02.material: Raibhurari yechikoro ine chiziviso 'Mudzidzi wese ane 190 cm kana kupfuura anoshandisa kamuri yekuverenga B'. Rega p ive 'ine 190 cm kana kupfuura' uye q ive 'anoshandisa kamuri yekuverenga B', uye uongorore proposition 'kana p ipapo q' uchitora vadzidzi 24 vekirasi 2 yegiredhi 3 se universal set. Data ichabuda nhanho nenhanho.
z-m-35-02.thinking.0: Kugadzirisa kutonga nechiyero chekuvimba neruzivo rutsva
z-m-35-02.thinking.1: Kusiyanisa chokwadi che proposition kana universal set ichichinja
z-m-35-02.prereq.1: Kuti proposition 'kana p ipapo q' ibhuku kana pane element (muenzaniso unopokana) umo p iri chokwadi uye q iri nhema
z-m-35-02.s.s1.prompt: Data inobuda imwe panguva. Panhanho yega yega, sarudza kutonga kwakakodzera zvikuru. Hauna kudikanwa kuchinja kutonga kwako kubva panhanho yapfuura.
z-m-35-02.s.s1.hint.0: Panhanho yega yega, tanga waverenga kana pane 'vadzidzi vanogutsa p'.
z-m-35-02.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora kuti mudzidzi akaita sei aizofanira kuvapo kuti ive 'nhema', uye utsvage mudzidzi akadaro mudata iripo.
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.0.info: Wakayera kureba kwevadzidzi vose 24 vekirasi 2 yegiredhi 3 uye vakanga vari kubva pa168 cm kusvika pa187 cm. Hapana mudzidzi mumwe chete ane 190 cm kana kupfuura. Hapana marekodhi ekushandiswa kwekamuri yekuverenga B parizvino.
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: Uchitora vadzidzi 24 ava se universal set, ungatonga sei proposition 'kana mudzidzi ane 190 cm kana kupfuura, anoshandisa kamuri yekuverenga B'?
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.0.after: 'Kana p ipapo q' ibhuku kana pane kunyange element imwe chete (muenzaniso unopokana) umo p iri chokwadi uye q iri nhema, uye ichokwadi kana pasina. Mukirasi iyi hapana mudzidzi anogutsa p, saka hapana muenzaniso unopokana unogona kuvapo, saka mumasvomhu inoonekwa sechokwadi (b). Kunzwa kwe c kwekuti 'hazvisvike pakushanda' kwakajairika mukutaura kwezuva nezuva, asi rangarirawo kuti chokwadi che proposition chinosarudzwa nenzira iyi.
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Hapana mudzidzi ane 190 cm kana kupfuura, saka mutemo hauzivikanwi kuti unoshanda, saka ibhuku
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Kuti ive 'nhema', panofanira kuva nemudzidzi (muenzaniso unopokana) umo p iri chokwadi uye q iri nhema. Tanga waongorora kana mudzidzi akadaro anogona kuvapo mukirasi iyi.
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Hapana mudzidzi anogona kupokana nacho, saka haigoni kunzi nhema, saka ichokwadi
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakashandisa chokwadi chekuti kana pasina mudzidzi anogutsa p, muenzaniso unopokana hauwanikwe.
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Hapana vadzidzi vanoshanda kwavari, saka zvakaoma kutaura kubva padata yekirasi iyi kana ichitevedzwa
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Iyi inzira yakajairika yekutaura muhupenyu hwezuva nezuva. Asi sezvo chokwadi che proposition chinosarudzwa nekuti pane muenzaniso unopokana here, enderera mberi kufunga kuti 'hapana muenzaniso unopokana' unobatwa sei.
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Hatizivi marekodhi ekushandiswa kwekamuri yekuverenga B, saka hatigoni kuita kutonga chero kupi
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Kunyange kana usingazivi q, kana pasina mudzidzi anogutsa p, hapana muenzaniso unopokana unobuda zvisinei ne q. Tanga wataridza kana pane mudzidzi umo p iri chokwadi.
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Svondo rinouya mudzidzi anotamira ane 192 cm achabatana nekirasi iyi. Hatisati taziva kana mudzidzi uyu achashandisa kamuri yekuverenga B.
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.1.ask: Mushure mekunge mudzidzi anotamira asvika, nevadzidzi 25 se universal set, chii chinoitika kana ukatonga proposition imwe chete zvino?
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.1.after: Mudzidzi anotamira anogutsa p. Kana mudzidzi iyeye asingashandisi kamuri yekuverenga B, p ichokwadi uye q inhema, ichigadzira muenzaniso unopokana, saka proposition yevadzidzi 25 ibhuku, uye kana achishandisa, hapana muenzaniso unopokana, saka ichokwadi. Hatisati taziva kana mudzidzi achishandisa, saka proposition yevadzidzi 25 haigoni kutongwa parizvino, uye sezvo mudzidzi mumwe chete akakwana, hapana chikonzero chekumirira zvakare.
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Mudzidzi mumwe anotamira haakwani, saka rega kutonga kudzike kusvikira vadzidzi vakawanda vane 190 cm kana kupfuura vauya
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Mudzidzi mumwe akakwana kuita muenzaniso unopokana. Funga kuti nei uchifunga kuti huwandu hwakati hwevadzidzi hunofanira kuunganidzwa usati wagona kutonga.
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Yatogadziriswa sechokwadi mukirasi iyi, saka haizochinji kunyange kana mudzidzi anotamira achisvika
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Chokwadi che proposition chinogona kuchinja ne universal set. Tarisa kuti mudzidzi mutsva kugutsa p kune chiitiko chipi.
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Vadzidzi vakareba vanotarisirwa kushandisa kamuri yekuverenga B, saka igadzirise sechokwadi zvino
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Kuti mudzidzi anoshandisa here chokwadi chinosimbiswa nemarekodhi, kwete kufungidzira. Siyanisa ruzivo rwakasimbiswa netarisiro.
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Zvinoenderana nokuti mudzidzi anoshandisa here. Kana asingashandisi, ibhuku, uye kana achishandisa, ichokwadi
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Wakacherekedza kuti sezvo pane mudzidzi anogutsa p kekutanga, kuti q yemudzidzi iyeye ichokwadi kana nhema kuchasarudza chokwadi che proposition.
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.2.info: Mudzidzi anotamira asvika, uye pakuongorora, vanoti mudzidzi haashandisi kamuri yekuverenga B. Ruzivo rwevadzidzi 24 vepakutanga haruna kuchinja.
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ungapfupisa sei proposition yevadzidzi 25 nekutonga kwakaitwa kuvadzidzi 24 vepakutanga?
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Kune vadzidzi 25, mudzidzi anotamira, ane 192 cm uye asingashandisi kamuri yekuverenga B, muenzaniso unopokana, saka proposition ibhuku. Kutonga kwevadzidzi 24 vepakutanga (chokwadi) kunoramba kwakarurama kune universal set iyoyo. Kutonga hakuna kuipa; chinhu chaitaurwa nezvacho chakachinja, uye kana muenzaniso unopokana wabuda, ibhuku zvisinei nemarekodhi evamwe vadzidzi.
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Ibhuku kune vadzidzi 25, uye 'chokwadi' kune vadzidzi 24 chinoramba chakarurama kuset iyoyo
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wakasiyanisa universal set kuchinja nekutonga kwekutanga kuva kwakaipa.
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Kutonga kwekutanga kwakaipa, saka kwevadzidzi 24 kunofanira kugadziriswa kuita nhema futi
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Pakati pe24 pakanga pasina mudzidzi ane 190 cm kana kupfuura, saka pakanga pasina muenzaniso unopokana. Chakachinja i universal set.
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Pane mudzidzi mumwe chete anotamira, saka rinotevedzwa zvakanyanya, saka ndichiriona sechokwadi
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: 'Kana p ipapo q' ichokwadi kwete kana ichishanda zvakanyanya asi kana pasina muenzaniso unopokana mumwe chete. 'Inoshanda zvakanyanya' chirevo chakasiyana.
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Rega kutonga kusvikira marekodhi ekushandiswa evamwe vadzidzi vose asimbiswa
z-m-35-02.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Vamwe 24 havagutsi p. Funga kana marekodhi avo angachinja kuti pane muenzaniso unopokana here.
z-m-35-02.s.s1.reflect: Pamatanho matatu, chii chakachinja uye chii chakaramba chakafanana mukutonga kwangu? Kana ukasiyanisa 'hapana nyaya yekuongorora' ne 'hapana nyaya inopokana', kutonga kwedanho rekutanga kunochinja sei?
z-m-35-02.s.s2.prompt: Uchishandisa izwi rekuti 'muenzaniso unopokana', tsanangurira shamwari kuti nei 'kana p ipapo q' ichiitwa sechokwadi kana pasina element inogutsa p zvachose. Wedzerawo muenzaniso mumwe wechimiro chakafanana (mamiriro enhamba).
z-m-35-02.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wanyora mumutsara mumwe kuti element yakaita sei yaizofanira kuvapo kuti 'kana p ipapo q' ive nhema.
z-m-35-02.s.s2.hint.1: Gadzira mamiriro mamwe (nezvenhamba) umo pasina element inogutsa p, uye uedze kana chirevo chinoti element iyoyo inofanira kuvapo chinoshanda.
z-m-35-02.s.s2.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Kuti ive nhema, paizofanira kuva ..., asi ...
z-m-35-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ndakatanga ndataura here 'chinhu chimwe chinofanira kuvapo chii kuti ive nhema'?
z-m-35-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ndakabatanidza here kuti nei chinhu icho chisingagone kuvapo nechokwadi chekuti pasina element inogutsa p?
z-m-35-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Muenzaniso wandakawedzera chaizvoizvo mamiriro umo pasina nhamba inogutsa p here?
z-m-35-02.s.s2.model.0: Kuti ichokwadi kana nhema kunosarudzwa nekuti pane muenzaniso unopokana here. Kana pasina mudzidzi mumwe chete ane 190 cm kana kupfuura, hapana mudzidzi akadaro asingashandisi kamuri yekuverenga B, ndiko kuti, hapana muenzaniso unopokana, saka haigoni kunzi nhema, saka ndinoiona sechokwadi. Semuenzaniso wechimiro chakafanana, 'kana x inhamba chaiyo uye x²<0, ipapo x>5' haina nhamba chaiyo ine x²<0, saka hapana muenzaniso unopokana, saka ichokwadi.
z-m-35-02.s.s2.model.1: Kuti "kana p ipapo q" ive nhema, panofanira kuva nenyaya imwe chete kana kupfuura umo p iri chokwadi uye q isina kururama. Asi kana pasina nyaya inogutsa p zvachose, muenzaniso unopokana wakadaro hauwanikwe, saka ichokwadi. Semuenzaniso, "kana x² < 0 kunhamba chaiyo x, ipapo x > 5" ichokwadiwo nokuti hapana x chaiyo ine x² < 0. Mushure mema sets, ndiyo nyaya imwe chete ne empty set kuva subset yeset ipi neipi.

z-m-35-04.prereq.0: H1 yebasa iri ingori chinyorwa chekuoma chebatch yekugadzira, kwete kuiswa kugiredhi mukharikhulamu. Inofungidzira kuti mudzidzi atodzidza kamwe chikamu che 'sets and propositions' cheCommon Mathematics yechikoro chesekondari (operations pa sets, proposition 'kana p ipapo q', nemienzaniso inopokana).
z-m-35-04.title: Kana mutengo mumwe usiri weseti ipi neipi
z-m-35-04.topic: Truth set yemamiriro nemutengo wemuganhu (kana pane chiratidzo che equal)
z-m-35-04.goal: Tarisa kuti mutengo wemuganhu uri kupi mutruth set ye inequality condition kutonga kana 'kana' inogara i chokwadi, uye uvake iwe pachako zviitiko zvakati wandei zvinogutsa miganhu mumamiriro apo nzvimbo yechiratidzo che equal yachinja.
z-m-35-04.material: Kune real number x, gadza mamiriro netruth sets dzawo seizvi. [가] p: x<a, q: x>b. [나] p: x<a, q: x≥b. Pano a ne b i constants, uye P ne Q i truth sets dze p ne q imwe neimwe. Minjae akagadzirisa chiitiko a=b=3 mu [가] seizvi. (Maitiro ekuverenga: ≥ zvinoreva 'hombe kana yakaenzana', uye x<a zvinoreva 'x i diki kupfuura a'.)
z-m-35-04.thinking.2: Kuvaka mhinduro dzakati wandei mukati memiganhu
z-m-35-04.prereq.1: Kuratidza truth sets dze inequalities x<a ne x≥b panumber line
z-m-35-04.prereq.2: Kuti truth set yemamiriro 'p kana q' i P∪Q
z-m-35-04.s.s1.prompt: Mutsetse wekutanga mukugadzirisa kwaMinjae apo logic inoenda zvisirizvo uri kupi? Verenga nhamba dzemitsetse kubva ku 1.
z-m-35-04.s.s1.hint.0: Uchishandisa p ne q yakagadzwa mumutsetse 1, rongedza real number imwe neimwe sekuti i ye p kana q.
z-m-35-04.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kuti ma x api akasanganisirwa muna "kune real number x yese," uye utarise mutsetse nemutsetse kana mutsetse wega wega wakabata ma x ese iwayo.
z-m-35-04.s.s1.line.0: Regai a=b=3. Ipapo p i x<3 uye q i x>3.
z-m-35-04.s.s1.line.1: Kana x i diki kupfuura 3, p i chokwadi, uye kana x i hombe kupfuura 3, q i chokwadi.
z-m-35-04.s.s1.line.2: Chiitiko x=3 hachisi diki kana hombe kupfuura 3, saka hachisi cherutivi rupi norupi uye hatifanire kuchifunga zvakasiyana.
z-m-35-04.s.s1.line.3: Saka, kune real numbers x dzese, 'p kana q' i chokwadi.
z-m-35-04.s.s1.explain: Dambudziko i kuti mumutsetse 3 unozvitaurira kuti x=3 haisi yemamiriro ose maviri wobva wati 'hatifanire kuifunga zvakasiyana'. 'Kune real numbers x dzese' inosanganisira x=3 zvakare, uye kana p ne q zvose zvakaipa pa x=3, saka 'p kana q' i manyepo, saka mu [가] haugone kutaura kuti kana a=b i chokwadi kune real numbers dzese. Mhedziso yemutsetse 4 yakaipa nekuda kwemutsetse 3.
z-m-35-04.s.s2.prompt: Zvino, mu [나] (p: x<a, q: x≥b), gadzira mapeya 3 akasiyana (a, b) anogutsa zvese zvinotevera. (i) 'p kana q' i chokwadi kune real numbers x dzese. (ii) Pane integers x 2 chaizvo dzinogutsa p ne q panguva imwechete. a ne b dzinogona kuva ma decimals.
z-m-35-04.s.s2.hint.0: Dhonza P ne Q panumber line uye usarudze kuti b ne a dzinofanira kuva kupi kuti dzibatane pasina kuchinya.
z-m-35-04.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora ma integers ari muchikamu kubva ku b kusvika asina kusvika ku a, uye ugadzirise a ne b kuti pave ne 2 chaizvo.
z-m-35-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Kana b i hombe kupfuura a, nhamba kubva ku a kusvika asina kusvika ku b dzinogutsa kwete p kana q.
z-m-35-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Pane integers 2 chaizvo kubva ku b kusvika asina kusvika ku a (mamiriro (ii)).
z-m-35-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Nhamba yema integers kubva ku b kusvika asina kusvika ku a haisi 2.
z-m-35-04.s.s2.explain: Mu [나], P i pasi pe a, uye Q i b kana kumusoro. Kuti union ive real numbers dzese, b≤a inodiwa, uye nhamba dzinogutsa zvose panguva imwechete i dzinobva ku b kusvika dzisina kusvika ku a. Zvinokwana kuti pave ne integers 2 chaizvo mukati, saka semuenzaniso (3,1) ine 1, 2, (2.5,0.5) ine 1, 2, uye (4.2,2.3) ine 3, 4. Kana b=a, hapana nhamba dzinopindirana chose, saka (ii) haigutswi.
z-m-35-04.s.s2.because.prompt: Tsanangura kuti P ne Q dzinobatana sei mu [나] kana b=a, uye kuti izvi zvakasiyana sei nechikonzero cheiko a=b imwechete yaiva dambudziko mu [가].
z-m-35-04.s.s2.because.hint.0: Gadza a=b=3 uye uise x=3 mu p ne q ye [나], uye unyore kana imwe neimwe i chokwadi kana manyepo.
z-m-35-04.s.s2.because.hint.1: Enzanisa nekuisa x=3 imwechete mu p ne q ye [가].
z-m-35-04.s.s2.because.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Mu [나], x=a inopinda mu ... saka ...
z-m-35-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ndakataura kuti x=a inopinda museti ipi, zvakasiyana ku [나] ne [가] here?
z-m-35-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ndakacherekedza kuti P ne Q i complements dzemumwe nemumwe kana kuti hapana nhamba inopindirana here?
z-m-35-04.s.s2.because.model.0: Mu [나], kana a=b, P i pasi pe a uye Q i a kana kumusoro, saka x=a inopinda mu Q. Saka union i real numbers dzese, uye hapana x inopindirana, saka dzi complements dzemumwe nemumwe. Mu [가], q haina chiratidzo che equal, saka x=a haipindi mu P kana Q.
z-m-35-04.s.s2.because.model.1: Chinosiyana i kuti ndiani anowana mutengo wemuganhu x=a. Mu [나], q i 'hombe kana yakaenzana', saka inosanganisira a uye hapana kuchinya, asi [가] i 'hombe', saka a yasiiwa. Saka mu [가], kunyangwe a=b, haisi chokwadi nguva dzose.
z-m-35-04.s.s2.because.model.2: Mu [나], kana b=a, P i x<a uye Q i x≥a, saka dzinopatsanura real numbers dzese pasina kupindirana, asi mu [가], x=3 haipindi mu P kana Q, saka union haisi real numbers dzese.

z-m-35-05.prereq.0: H1 yebasa iri ingori chinyorwa chekuoma chebatch yekugadzira, kwete kuiswa kugiredhi mukharikhulamu. Inofungidzira kuti mudzidzi atodzidza kamwe chikamu che 'sets and propositions' cheCommon Mathematics yechikoro chesekondari (operations pa sets, proposition 'kana p ipapo q', nemienzaniso inopokana).
z-m-35-05.title: Mitsara miviri ine mashoko akafanana akarongwa zvakasiyana: ine zvairevo zvakafanana here?
z-m-35-05.goal: Shandisa tafura kutarisa kuti mitsara miviri inosiyana nekurongeka kwe 'kune ... wese pane' ne 'mumwe ... kune wese' haitsigirane, uye utsvage kubatana kwakaipa uye utsanangure nemuenzaniso unopokana.
z-m-35-05.material: Vadzidzi vana 가, 나, 다, 라 vakatumirana manotsi ekurudzira. Hapana akazvitumira pachake. Mutsetse wega wega wetafura i 'anotumira → vanogamuchira'. [Tafura 1] 가→나, 다, 라 / 나→다 / 다→나 / 라→다. [Tafura 2] 가→나 / 나→다 / 다→라 / 라→가. Chirevo ㄱ: Kune mudzidzi wese, pane mudzidzi akatumira notsi kumudzidzi iyoyo. Chirevo ㄴ: Mumwe mudzidzi akatumira notsi kune mumwe wese.
z-m-35-05.thinking.2: Kutsanangura hukama hwe logic nema counterexamples
z-m-35-05.prereq.1: Zvinoreva 'kune x yese' ne 'pane x kuti'
z-m-35-05.s.s1.hint.0: Verenga tafura nemutsetse wekutumira kuna ㄴ, uye gamuchiri mumwe panguva kuna ㄱ.
z-m-35-05.s.s1.hint.1: Kutarisa ㄱ, nyora mumwe panguva kana pane mudzidzi akatumira kuna 가, 나, 다, 라.
z-m-35-05.s.s1.r.a: Kuna ㄱ unofanira kuongorora 'rutivi rwekugamuchira' kumudzidzi wega wega. Verenga tafura zvakatwasuka uye utarise kana pane mudzidzi asina kugamuchira kubva kunaani.
z-m-35-05.s.s1.o.b: Zvose ㄱ ne ㄴ i chokwadi
z-m-35-05.s.s1.r.b: Tarisa kana zvirevo zviviri zvichiverenga tafura munzira imwechete. ㄱ inotarisa rutivi rwekugamuchira, uye ㄴ inotarisa rutivi rwekutumira.
z-m-35-05.s.s1.o.c: Zvose ㄱ ne ㄴ i manyepo
z-m-35-05.s.s1.r.c: Kutarisa ㄴ, tarisa mutsetse nemutsetse kana mutsetse mumwe unosanganisira vadzidzi vatatu vamwe vese.
z-m-35-05.s.s1.r.d: Iyi i mhedzisiro yekutarisa, pamutsetse wemutumiri, kana mudzidzi mumwe akatumira kune vamwe vese, uye kutarisa zvakasiyana, parutivi rwekugamuchira, kana mudzidzi wese akagamuchira imwe.
z-m-35-05.s.s1.explain: Mu [Tafura 1], 가 akatumira kune vose 나, 다, 라, saka ㄴ i chokwadi. Asi hapana akatumira notsi kuna 가, saka ㄱ i manyepo.
z-m-35-05.s.s2.prompt: Harin akati ㄴ i chokwadizve mu [Tafura 2] uye akatsanangura seizvi. Mutsetse upi ndiwo wekutanga apo logic inoenda zvisirizvo? Nhamba dzemitsetse dzinoverengwa kubva ku 1.
z-m-35-05.s.s2.hint.0: Mu [Tafura 2], tarisa mutsetse nemutsetse kana mutsetse waka 가 unosanganisira vadzidzi vatatu vamwe vese.
z-m-35-05.s.s2.hint.1: Enzanisa nechirevo che ㄴ pfungwa yekuti mu ㄱ, 'mutumiri' wemudzidzi wese anogona kuva mudzidzi mumwechete kana wakasiyana.
z-m-35-05.s.s2.line.0: Mu [Tafura 2], 가 akatumira kuna 나, 나 akatumira kuna 다, 다 akatumira kuna 라, uye 라 akatumira kuna 가.
z-m-35-05.s.s2.line.1: Kutarisa rutivi rwekugamuchira, imwe neimwe ye 가, 나, 다, 라 yakagamuchira notsi kamwe, saka ㄱ i chokwadi.
z-m-35-05.s.s2.line.2: Mudzidzi wese kugamuchira notsi zvinoreva kuti pane mutumiri wemudzidzi wese, saka zvinotevera kuti mumwe mudzidzi akatumira kune vamwe vadzidzi vese.
z-m-35-05.s.s2.explain: Kusvika mumutsetse 2 zvakarurama (ㄱ i chokwadi mu [Tafura 2]). Mutsetse 3 unoenda zvisirizvo mukutaura kuti kubva ku 'kune mudzidzi wese pane mutumiri' (mutumiri anogona kusiyana kumugamuchiri wega wega), 'mudzidzi mumwe akatumira kune wese' (mutumiri mumwechete kune wese) kunotevera. Mu [Tafura 2], mudzidzi wese akatumira kumunhu mumwe chete, saka ㄴ i manyepo. Mhedziso yemutsetse 4 yakaipa nekuda kwemutsetse 3.
z-m-35-05.s.s3.prompt: Zvichibva pamatafura maviri, tonga kana 'kana ㄴ i chokwadi saka ㄱ inofanira kuva chokwadi' uye 'kana ㄱ i chokwadi saka ㄴ inofanira kuva chokwadi' zvega zvichigara zvichishanda, uye unyore kuti tafura ipi i humbowo hwekutonga kwega kwega.
z-m-35-05.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora kana ㄱ ne ㄴ i chokwadi kana manyepo mu [Tafura 1], uye uite zvimwechete ku [Tafura 2].
z-m-35-05.s.s3.hint.1: Shandisa chokwadi chekuti kana pane tafura apo imwe i chokwadi uye imwe i manyepo, 'inofanira' munzira iyoyo inoparara.
z-m-35-05.s.s3.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Kunyangwe ㄴ i chokwadi, ㄱ ... muTafura 1 ...
z-m-35-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ndakatonga nzira mbiri dzega dzega (ㄴ→ㄱ, ㄱ→ㄴ) zvakasiyana here?
z-m-35-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Mumatafura andakapa, ndakacherekedza nenzira chaiyo kuti chirevo chimwe i chokwadi uye chimwe i manyepo here?
z-m-35-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ndakataura nemashoko angu pachangu kuti zvinoreva zvinochinja kana kurongeka kwe 'zvese' ne 'mamwe' kwakasiyana here?
z-m-35-05.s.s3.model.0: Hapana inogara ichishanda. MuTafura 1, ㄴ i chokwadi asi ㄱ i manyepo nekuti hapana akatumira kuna 가. MuTafura 2, ㄱ i chokwadi asi ㄴ i manyepo (mutumiri wese akatumira kumunhu mumwe chete). Saka pane counterexample imwe kune imwe neimwe.
z-m-35-05.s.s3.model.1: Kunyangwe ㄴ i chokwadi, hapana vimbiso yekuti ㄱ i chokwadi (Tafura 1 i counterexample), uye kunyangwe ㄱ i chokwadi, hapana vimbiso yekuti ㄴ i chokwadi (Tafura 2 i counterexample). Kuti mudzidzi wese ane mutumiri nekuti mudzidzi mumwe akatumira kune wese zvinoreva zvinhu zvakasiyana nekuti kurongeka kwe 'zvese' ne 'mamwe' kwakasiyana.
z-m-35-05.s.s3.model.2: Mutafura 1, ㄴ i chokwadi uye ㄱ i manyepo, uye mutafura 2, ㄱ i chokwadi uye ㄴ i manyepo, saka hapana inovimbiswa.

z-m-35-06.prereq.0: H1 yebasa iri ingori chinyorwa chekuoma chebatch yekugadzira, kwete kuiswa kugiredhi mukharikhulamu. Inofungidzira kuti mudzidzi atodzidza kamwe chikamu che 'sets and propositions' cheCommon Mathematics yechikoro chesekondari (operations pa sets, proposition 'kana p ipapo q', nemienzaniso inopokana).
z-m-35-06.title: Kuvaka iwe pachako mamiriro maviri ane nhamba yakagadzwa yema counterexamples
z-m-35-06.topic: Kuverenga ma counterexamples e proposition 'kana p saka q' neye converse yayo (kuisanganisira kwema truth sets)
z-m-35-06.goal: Shandisa chokwadi chekuti musiyano wema truth sets i seti yema counterexamples kugadzira iwe pachako mamiriro maviri anogutsa miganhu panhamba yema counterexamples, uye uenzanise mhinduro dzakati wandei.
z-m-35-06.material: Neuniversal set U={1, 2, 3, …, 12}, funga mamiriro maviri p: x≥a, q: x≤b. a ne b i integers kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 12, uye P ne Q i truth sets dze p ne q imwe neimwe. Counterexample ku proposition 'kana p saka q' i element ye U apo p i chokwadi uye q i manyepo, uye counterexample ku converse yayo 'kana q saka p' i element apo q i chokwadi uye p i manyepo. (Maitiro ekuverenga: x≥a i 'x i a kana kupfuura', uye x≤b i 'x i b kana kushoma'.)
z-m-35-06.prereq.2: Converse ye proposition, 'kana q saka p'
z-m-35-06.s.s1.prompt: Ndeupi unotaura zvakanaka zvikuru ma counterexamples e proposition 'kana p saka q' uchishandisa truth sets P ne Q?
z-m-35-06.s.s1.hint.0: Sarudza element imwe kana mbiri ye U iwe pachako dzinoenderana nezvinoreva counterexample ('mamiriro p i chokwadi asi mhedziso q i manyepo').
z-m-35-06.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora kuti element iyoyo i ye P kana Q ipi uye isiri yeipi.
z-m-35-06.s.s1.o.a: Element ye P isiri ye Q (P−Q)
z-m-35-06.s.s1.r.a: Wakashandura zvinoreva counterexample, 'p i chokwadi asi q i manyepo', kuita mutauro weseti.
z-m-35-06.s.s1.o.b: Element ye Q isiri ye P (Q−P)
z-m-35-06.s.s1.r.b: Ma elements aya ndiwo anoparadza 'kana q saka p'. Tarisa zvakare chokwadi chekuti counterexample i element apo 'rutivi rwemamiriro i chokwadi uye rutivi rwemhedziso i manyepo'.
z-m-35-06.s.s1.o.c: Element ye P ne Q zvose (P∩Q)
z-m-35-06.s.s1.r.c: Element apo p ne q zvose i chokwadi haiparadze 'kana p saka q' uye inototsigira. Enzanisa nezvinoreva counterexample.
z-m-35-06.s.s1.o.d: Element isiri ye P kana Q
z-m-35-06.s.s1.r.d: Enzanisa nezvinoreva counterexample kuti element apo p ne q zvose i manyepo ine basa rei mu 'kana p saka q'.
z-m-35-06.s.s1.explain: Counterexample ku 'kana p saka q' i element apo p i chokwadi uye q i manyepo, ndiko kuti, element ye P isiri ye Q, saka i P−Q (=P∩Qᶜ). Counterexample ku converse 'kana q saka p' i Q−P.
z-m-35-06.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira (a, b) 3 dzakasiyana dzinogutsa mamiriro ese anotevera. (i) Pane ma counterexamples 3 chaizvo ku 'kana p saka q' muna U. (ii) Converse 'kana q saka p' ine counterexample 1 kana kupfuura uye shoma kupfuura 3.
z-m-35-06.s.s2.hint.0: Gadza a ne b imwe, nyora P ne Q nenhamba kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 12, uye uverenge nhamba dzine P chete.
z-m-35-06.s.s2.hint.1: Kuti pave nenhamba 3 dzine P chete, sarudza kuti P inofanira kutanga kupi uye Q inofanira kupera kupi, wobva watarisa kuti nhamba dzingani dzine Q chete.
z-m-35-06.s.s2.ok.c0: a ne b i integers kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 12.
z-m-35-06.s.s2.fail.c0: a ne b dzinofanira kuva integers kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 12.
z-m-35-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Pane ma counterexamples 3 chaizvo ku 'kana p saka q'.
z-m-35-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Nhamba yema counterexamples ku 'kana p saka q' haisi 3.
z-m-35-06.s.s2.ok.c3: Converse ine mienzaniso inopikisa iri pasi pe3.
z-m-35-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Converse ine mienzaniso inopikisa 3 kana kupfuura.
z-m-35-06.s.s2.explain: P={a, …, 12}, Q={1, …, b}. P−Q ndiyo nhamba kubva pa max(a, b+1) kusvika ku12, saka kuti huwandu huve 3, max(a, b+1)=10. Zvakare Q−P ndiyo nhamba kubva ku1 kusvika ku min(b, a−1), saka huwandu hwemienzaniso inopikisa ye converse ndi min(b, a−1), uye inofanira kuva 1 kana 2. Mapeya anogoneka ndi mana chete (2,9), (3,9), (10,1), (10,2).
z-m-35-06.s.s3.prompt: Sarudza mapeya maviri pakati pe (a, b) awakawana ane zvimiro zvakasiyana, enzanisa kuti P ne Q zviri sei mumarondedzero enhamba (kana zvichifukidzana kana zvakaparadzana), uye unyore kuti nei mapeya maviri anogutsa mamiriro.
z-m-35-06.s.s3.hint.0: Kune peya imwe neimwe yawakawana, nyora P ne Q uchishandisa nhamba 1 kusvika ku12 uye utarise kana nhamba ipi neipi iri mumaseti ose maviri.
z-m-35-06.s.s3.hint.1: Kana zvine zvimiro zvakasiyana, enzanisa kuti seti ipi iri kumagumo.
z-m-35-06.s.s3.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Kune (2, 9), P ndi ..., uye kune (10, 1), ...
z-m-35-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Kumapeya maviri, ndakanyora zvakananga nhamba dziri muna P chete nedziri muna Q chete here?
z-m-35-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ndakataura zvakajeka kuti zvimiro zvemapeya maviri zvinosiyana sei (kana zvichifukidzana) here?
z-m-35-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ndakatarisa kana pane mamwe mapeya andakasiya here?
z-m-35-06.s.s3.model.0: Kana (a, b)=(2, 9), P ndi2 kusvika ku12 uye Q ndi1 kusvika ku9, saka zvinofukidzana. 10, 11, 12 dziri muna P chete ndidzo mienzaniso inopikisa 3, uye 1 iri muna Q chete muenzaniso 1 unopikisa we converse. Kana (10, 1), P ndi10 kusvika ku12 uye Q ingori 1, saka zvakaparadzana, 10, 11, 12 dziri muna P chete ndidzo mienzaniso inopikisa 3, uye 1 iri muna Q chete muenzaniso 1 unopikisa we converse.
z-m-35-06.s.s3.model.1: Kana a=3, b=9, P ndi3 kana kupfuura uye Q ndi9 kana pasi, saka chikamu chinofukidzana ndi3 kusvika ku9, chikamu chiri muna P chete ndi10, 11, 12 (nhamba 3), uye chikamu chiri muna Q chete ndi1, 2 (nhamba 2). Mienzaniso inopikisa 2 ye converse iri pasi pe3. Kana a=10, b=2, saka P (10 kusvika ku12) ne Q (1 kusvika ku2) hazvifukidzani, nenhamba 3 dziri muna P chete nenhamba 2 dziri muna Q chete.
